rounds.name: Emoji Pictionary
rounds.blurb: 15 sets of emojis, each spelling out a Malayalam film title. Read it, decode it, name the film. Starts easy. Ends brutal.

questions.note: Vaazha = plantain: parents' word for useless sons. Vaazha: Biopic of a Billion Boys, written by Vipin Das (2024).
The Goat Life. Prithviraj as Najeeb, stranded in the Saudi desert (2024).
Tovino Thomas's Malayalam crime thriller, with Mamta Mohandas (2020).
A ghost in the city. Mammootty (2009).
Kishkindha, the monkey kingdom of the Ramayana. Asif Ali, Vijayaraghavan (2024).
Chandran + utsavam = a moon festival. Mohanlal, Ranjith (2005).
Neela = blue, velicham = light. Aashiq Abu's remake of Basheer's Bhargavi Nilayam; Tovino Thomas, Rima Kallingal (2023).
Vadakku = north, nokki = looking, yantram = machine: a compass. Sreenivasan as Thalathil Dinesan (1989).
Thuruppu = trump, gulan = jack: the trump jack in a card game. Mammootty (2006).
Amma = mother, kili = bird, koodu = nest. Prithviraj, Navya Nair (2003).
It rains, the maddalam drums. Priyadarshan, Mohanlal and Sreenivasan (1986).
Mazhavil = rainbow; the kavadi is the peacock-feather offering carried at Palani. Sathyan Anthikad, Jayaram (1989).
Lined eyes and a pottu on the forehead. Manju Warrier (1999).
Thooval = feather, sparsham = touch. Jayaram, Mukesh, Suresh Gopi and a baby (1990).
Mookilla = noseless, rajyam = kingdom: in the country of the noseless. Four asylum escapees; Thilakan, Mukesh, Jagathy (1991).

rounds.name: Terribly Explained Plots
rounds.blurb: We explain a Malayalam film's plot. Badly. In English and Manglish, mixed. You name the film. A wrong answer costs you 5.

questions.prompt: Seven unemployed boys, oru Bengaluru veedu. Decisions ellam edukkunnathu a board game aanu. The board has opinions, chilappo attitude-um.
questions.hint: THE PLOT, BADLY EXPLAINED
questions.note: 2023 · The Ouija board comedy-horror. Jithu Madhavan.

questions.prompt: Abroad pokaan plan cheythu, visa kittiyilla. So he 'studies' in another city. Syllabus: oru IT company-ile penkutty. Result: pending.
questions.hint: THE PLOT, BADLY EXPLAINED
questions.note: 2024 · Naslen as Sachin, Mamitha Baiju as Reenu.

questions.prompt: New bride, old tharavadu. Ellaarum paranju 'that room thurakkaruthu.' She did. Ippo raathri dance practice-um, oru foreign-returned doctor-inu overtime-um.
questions.hint: THE PLOT, BADLY EXPLAINED
questions.note: 1993 · Shobana as Ganga, Mohanlal as Dr. Sunny.

questions.prompt: Randu chunk bros, Dubai dream-il oru boat kayari. Gulf aanennu paranju irakkiyathu Madras beach-il. Next career: CID. Training? Zero. Confidence? Full.
questions.hint: THE PLOT, BADLY EXPLAINED
questions.note: 1987 · Dasan and Vijayan, dropped in Madras by Gafoorka.

questions.prompt: Oru veedu, randu party office. Makkal randum full-time neta, part-time useless. Dinner table daily oru assembly session. Achan: 'Njan ini evide poyi irikkum?'
questions.hint: THE PLOT, BADLY EXPLAINED
questions.note: 1991 · Prabhakaran and Prakashan, rival parties. Sreenivasan, Jayaram, Thilakan.

questions.prompt: Tharavaattil oru rule: pennungal NO ENTRY. Pakshe oru makan already secret aayi family set aakki. Opposite veettukaarumaayi decades-old feud. Grandpa-kku BP, audience-inu chiri.
questions.hint: THE PLOT, BADLY EXPLAINED
questions.note: 1991 · Anjooran vs Aanappara Achamma; Swaminathan's secret wife. Siddique–Lal.

questions.prompt: Colony-il pudhiya penkutty vannu. Naalu velayilla payyanmar instantly line-il. Avarkku kittiyathu: penkutty alla, oru briefcase full cash, free gift aayi oru killer-um.

questions.note: 1990 · Mahadevan, Govindan Kutty, Appukuttan, Thomas Kutty, and John Honai.

questions.prompt: Bus yathra. Oru thaali maala kaanaathaayi, suspect athu breakfast aakki. Ippo full police station toilet-inte munnil waiting, X-ray-yum ready. Bonus twist: kallanum bharthaavinum same peru.
questions.hint: THE PLOT, BADLY EXPLAINED
questions.note: 2017 · Fahadh Faasil as the thief who calls himself Prasad. Dileesh Pothan.

questions.prompt: Thrissur-ile oru chettan: naattil full decent, town-il full 'ishtaa'. Oruthi-ye kalyanam kazhikkanam, mattoruthi-ye marakkaan pattunnilla. Aval varunnathu letter-ilum, pinne mazhayude koode. Weather app venda, aval undallo.
questions.hint: THE PLOT, BADLY EXPLAINED
questions.note: 1987 · Jayakrishnan, Radha and Clara. Padmarajan.

questions.prompt: Kalyanam kazhinju. Venam: kurachu privacy, oru biscuit business. Kittiyathu: government office-il file move aakunnilla, veettil aalkaarude count kurayunnilla. Honeymoon? Next year nokkaam.

questions.note: 2019 · Vinay Forrt as Srinivasan, the balding Malayalam professor. Chinnu Chandni as Chinnu.

questions.note: 2022 · Kunchacko Boban as Kozhummal Rajeevan.

rounds.name: The Jackpot Round
rounds.blurb: Ten questions on everything Mollywood. The biggest points of the night, and the biggest risk.

questions.prompt: Mohanlal's first film on screen: he played the villain, Narendran. Name the film.
questions.note: 1980, directed by Fazil.

questions.prompt: Priyadarshan's Hindi film Hungama (2003) is a remake of which of his own Malayalam films?
Fahadh Faasil debuted in 2002 in a film directed by his father, Fazil. Name it.
questions.note: He was credited as Shanu, and returned to films in 2009.

questions.prompt: Composer Sushin Shyam is a founding member of which Kerala folk-metal band?
questions.note: He scored Kumbalangi Nights, Varathan, Aavesham and Manjummel Boys.

questions.prompt: Which 1965 film was the first South Indian film to win the National Award for Best Feature Film?
questions.note: Directed by Ramu Kariat, from Thakazhi's novel.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the screenplays of Thaniyavarthanam, Kireedam and Bharatham?
questions.note: Thaniyavarthanam (1987) was his first screenplay.

questions.prompt: Who directed Elippathayam (1981)?
questions.note: It won the BFI's Sutherland Trophy.

questions.prompt: For which film did Meera Jasmine win the National Award for Best Actress?
questions.note: Directed by T.V. Chandran (2003).

questions.prompt: Which 1982 Navodaya film was the first Malayalam film shot in 70mm?
questions.note: Mammootty, Mohanlal and Prem Nazir.

questions.prompt: Which 1961 film was the first Malayalam film shot in colour?
questions.note: Directed by T.R. Sundaram.

tiebreak.prompt: Neelakuyil, the first Malayalam film to win a National Award (a President's silver medal), released in which year?
